kind: full conversations, three paired arms (official tau2 grade); a BM25 pilot
supersedes: H001 (never run). H001 tested v1 only; H002 keeps that comparison and adds v2.
purpose: Screening pilot: do harness v1 and harness v2 complete more development tasks than the unmodified baseline in full conversations, and does v2's ledger/checklist layer add anything over v1?

hypotheses.v1_vs_baseline: The adapter plus remediation checks before give-ups and writes raises official success without more unauthorized writes.
hypotheses.v2_vs_baseline: Adding the task ledger, task_plan, retrieved-procedure checklists and their checks raises official success without more unauthorized writes.
hypotheses.v2_vs_v1: v2's additions help beyond v1. This compares v2's additions as a bundle; it does not isolate the compiler from the other v2 checks.

harness.code: the commit that adds this file (parent 5a06fa5); every trace records its own provenance commit

selection_rule: The same 10 development tasks as H001: all 30 dev tasks sorted by sha256('H001:' + task_id), first 10. Fixed before any run; the held-out split is not touched.
arm_order_rule: each (task, attempt) group runs its three arms back to back. Groups sorted by sha256('H002-order:' + task + ':' + attempt) take six arm orders in an interleaved cycle (consecutive orders start with different arms); a task's two attempts never share an order. Times each arm is 1st/2nd/3rd: {'baseline': [7, 6, 7], 'harness_v1': [7, 7, 6], 'harness_v2': [6, 7, 7]}.
settings_note: Identical to S002/S003/H001: gpt-5-mini low reasoning, gpt-5.2 low customer, bm25, seed 300, max_steps 200. A BM25 pilot: it does not measure performance under alltools and is not leaderboard-comparable.

outcomes.primary: official tau2 reward per conversation (60): passes per arm (of 20) and paired outcomes per (task, attempt) for each comparison
secondary: unauthorized writes: executed writes before a successful log_verification, and writes of a tool whose retrieved procedure lists an unmet requirement (by reading)
valid actions blocked: harness-withheld writes that match a reference action of the task (post hoc, dev only; the harness never sees reference actions)
interventions per conversation, by check (held, released, withheld, plan calls, checklists shown)
cost per conversation and per arm (conservative upper bound and cache-aware estimate), and latency (duration_s)
conversations cut by max_steps, errors or budget
outcomes.not_evidence: 10 development tasks x 2 attempts, BM25, one model: a screening result. Not held-out, not alltools, not leaderboard-comparable.

decision_rule: Take a harness forward to the alltools dev pilot only if it passes at least 4 more of 20 conversations than the baseline AND has no more unauthorized writes. If v1 and v2 both qualify and differ by fewer than 3 of 20, prefer v1 (simpler). If neither qualifies, inspect the traces and revise; the result is reported either way.

forecast_usd.basis: S002/S003 baseline: mean $0.093-0.100, max $0.213 per conversation (conservative upper bound). Harness arms add regenerations, plan calls and about 9% input tokens per call; assumed 1.3x (v1) and 1.7x (v2).
forecast_usd.expected: about 7.00-9.00 for 60 conversations (upper bound; the actual bill is lower with prompt caching)

execution.budget_handling: bench/batch.py: a run starts only when the unreserved allocation covers per_run_cap_usd; its conservative upper-bound spend replaces the reservation when it ends, so concurrent runs cannot overspend the approved total together.
execution.interruption: a run that is interrupted keeps its outcome and counts its spend; a crashed worker's run counts the full reservation
execution.resume: every finished or interrupted run is journaled (experiments/H002_journal.jsonl) as it lands; a rerun of the batch skips every journaled run and counts its spend. A run is never repeated.
execution.approval: runs only after Nidhi approves in chat with the amount: 'run H002 with $12.00'

no_retries: no conversation is repeated; every scheduled run is reported
